---
title: Design once, use anywhere
---

## Overview

Learn how to work effectively with light and dark modes, brands, renderings, and multiple output formats, and how to share a consistent brand across multiple Quarto projects without duplication or fragility.

{{< include _slides.md >}}

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

* Enable and customize light and dark modes for HTML documents and websites.
* Define a brand with `_brand.yml`, including colors, typography, and logos.
* Apply a single brand consistently across multiple Quarto projects without duplication.
* Render the same branded content to multiple formats while preserving brand consistency.
